name: Travis Gray

tenures.role: authority: owner and president
tenures.note: The staff page lists "Owner/President: Travis Gray"; the news of 18 February 2008 has him release the stipulations for Vortex.

caption: Owner and president of the AWA in its news and staff list of 2008, who booked its shows and released the stipulations for Vortex.

name: Low

tenures.role: commissioner; World Heavyweight Champion from 30 June 2008
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 names "the AWA Commissioner, Low"; the champions panel: "Low won his 12th AWA World Heavyweight Championship from Logan Alexander on June 30, 2008".

caption: AWA Commissioner in February 2008 and its World Heavyweight Champion from 30 June 2008, with 27 career AWA championships by the fed's count.

identity.note: Shares the name Low with the GCW wrestler who won the Hardcore Championship on 11 April 2002 (low-gcw-gcwonline-2001). The AWA's Low is its Commissioner and, from 30 June 2008, its World Heavyweight Champion; neither record gives a moniker, hometown or manager to compare, so the records stay distinct until a document ties them.

name: Jason Storm

tenures.role: wrestler: World Heavyweight Champion in February 2008; United States Champion from 18 May 2008
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 calls him "the newly crowned champion, Jason Storm"; the champions panel: "Jason Storm defeated Evan Heir in a Nevada Knockout Match to win his first US title on May 18th, 2008".

caption: Newly crowned World champion in February 2008 and, from 18 May 2008, United States Champion, his third career AWA championship.

identity.note: Shares the name Jason Storm with records of EWA (August 1998), FWF (June 1998), the newsgroup record of 1998 to 2005 (G-Pro, VCW, VWF Vegas), VXW (July 2005) and WLW (December 2002). The AWA's Jason Storm is a wrestler of 2008 billed by name alone on these pages, with no moniker, hometown or manager to compare, so the records stay distinct until a document ties them.

name: Quade deSade

tenures.role: wrestler: tag partner of Jeff Christianson; No Limits Champion from 13 July 2008
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 bills the tag team of "Jeff Christianson and Quade deSade"; the champions panel: "Quade deSade won his 4th AWA No Limits Championship on July 13, 2008".

caption: Partner of Jeff Christianson in the Christiansons, said by Rawstarr to be his brother, and No Limits Champion for the fourth time from 13 July 2008 in Paris.

name: Jeff Christianson

tenures.role: wrestler: tag partner of Quade deSade; calls himself the BLUEPRINT
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 quotes him: "they call me the BLUEPRINT".

caption: AWA wrestler who in February 2008 defied its management to appear on his father's show in Montreal, where the NPD attacked him.

name: Jeff Christianson Sr.

tenures.role: promoter and owner of the Montreal show
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: "Jeff Christianson Sr., the promoter and owner" of the show in Montreal.

caption: Promoter and owner of the Montreal show at which the NPD attacked Jeff Christianson in February 2008.

name: Logan Alexander

tenures.role: wrestler: Cruiserweight Champion in February 2008; World Heavyweight Champion until 30 June 2008
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: "Logan Alexander defends his Cruiserweight Championship against Evan Heir"; the champions panel: "from Logan Alexander on June 30, 2008".

caption: Cruiserweight Champion in February 2008, billed to defend it against Evan Heir at Vortex, and the champion Low beat on 30 June 2008.

identity.note: Shares the name with the color commentator of the ICW card of 21 November 1999 (logan-alexander-icw-2000-nov1999). The AWA's Logan Alexander is a champion of 2008; nothing in either record ties them, so they stay distinct.

name: Evan Heir

tenures.role: wrestler: challenger for the Cruiserweight Championship at Vortex
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 books him against Logan Alexander; the champions panel: "Jason Storm defeated Evan Heir in a Nevada Knockout Match".

caption: Challenger for the Cruiserweight Championship at Vortex in February 2008 and Jason Storm's opponent on 18 May 2008.

name: Onslaught

tenures.role: wrestler: challenger for the No Limits Championship at Vortex
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 calls him "the despicable Onslaught" and hopes his match ends his career "so our Commissioner can live in peace without hearing the name of" Brian Stevens; the pages do not say whether Onslaught and Brian Stevens are one man, so they are two records. The AWA's release: "Onslaught will be held accountable and responsible for his actions."

caption: Challenger in the Triple Glass Table Match at Vortex whose champion was left in critical condition, for which the AWA said he would answer.

identity.note: Shares the one-word name Onslaught with seven records of other federations between 1997 and 2007 (a bodyguard, half of a tag team, tournament entrants, roster names). The AWA's Onslaught is a challenger of 2008 billed by that name alone, so nothing ties it to any of them and the records stay distinct.

name: Nathan Hawthorne-Lee

tenures.role: wrestler: No Limits Champion in February 2008; founder and president of Damage, Incorporated
tenures.note: Billed in February 2008 as "the champion and administration friend Sir Nathaniel Henry Lee GBE"; his wife speaks of "the condition of Nathan, my true husband"; the show news of 21 July 2008 asks "Will Nathan Hawthorne-Lee still be employed?". No page writes the billings as one name; they are read as one man on his initials, NHL, and his wife's surname.

caption: No Limits Champion in February 2008, left in critical condition by the Triple Glass Table Match at Vortex; in July 2008 the news asked whether he would still be employed or take a place in the main event of Classic.

name: Sarah Hawthorne

tenures.role: wife of Nathan Hawthorne-Lee in the news
tenures.note: In the news of 26 February 2008 she speaks of "Nathan, my true husband".

caption: Wife of Nathan Hawthorne-Lee, who spoke to AWA_Online after the Vortex accident.

name: Draven Shadows

tenures.role: wrestler: half of the NPD
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: "Rawstarr and Draven Shadows, the NPD".

caption: Half of the NPD, the team Travis Gray sent to the Montreal show in February 2008.

name: Rawstarr

tenures.role: wrestler: half of the NPD
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: "Rawstarr and Draven Shadows, the NPD"; he says "The NPD is the greatest entity ever created."

caption: Half of the NPD, the team Travis Gray sent to the Montreal show in February 2008.

name: Brad Pierce

tenures.role: wrestler: new to the roster, debuting at Vortex
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 welcomes "two new members to the AWA", Brad Pierce and Marcus Thompson, for a debut match at Vortex.

caption: New AWA member in February 2008, billed against Marcus Thompson at Vortex.

name: Marcus Thompson

tenures.role: wrestler: new to the roster, debuting at Vortex
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 welcomes "two new members to the AWA", Brad Pierce and Marcus Thompson, for a debut match at Vortex.

caption: New AWA member in February 2008, billed against Brad Pierce at Vortex.

name: Brian Williams

tenures.role: wrestler: in a Vortex match with Jayson Price that might end both careers
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: he and Jayson Price "put everything on the line", and he asked for a "Casket match".

caption: Billed in February 2008 against Jayson Price at Vortex, in a match that might end both their careers.

identity.note: Shares the name with the SEWF wrestler who returned in August 2000 (brian-williams-sewf). The AWA's Brian Williams is a wrestler of 2008 billed by name alone, so nothing ties the two and the records stay distinct.

name: Jayson "Misery" Price

tenures.role: wrestler: in a Vortex match with Brian Williams
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: Brian Williams and Jayson Price "put everything on the line" at Vortex.

caption: Billed in February 2008 against Brian Williams at Vortex.

name: A.C. Smith

tenures.role: wrestler: challenger for the World Heavyweight Championship at Vortex
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008: Jason Storm is to defend his title "against A.C. Smith" at Vortex.

caption: Challenger for the World Heavyweight Championship at Vortex, having won a triple threat match against Brian Williams and Jayson Price.

name: Brian Stevens

tenures.role: wrestler: named as a main-event name in 2008
tenures.note: The news of 18 February 2008 looks ahead to "a Brian Stevens-free main event" at Vortex and hopes Onslaught's career ends "so our Commissioner can live in peace without hearing the name of" Brian Stevens (the pages do not say whether the two are one man); the show news of 21 July 2008 asks whether a rival will take his spot in the main event of Classic.

caption: Named by the AWA's own bulletins in 2008 as a man whose name the Commissioner tired of hearing and whose main-event place was in question.

name: Tyler Harrison

tenures.role: wrestler: in the No Limits match of 13 July 2008
tenures.note: The champions panel: "in a match featuring Tyler Harrison in Paris, France" on July 13, 2008.

caption: Named in the 13 July 2008 No Limits Championship match in Paris won by Quade deSade.

name: Richard Fitzwell

tenures.role: rumor reporter for AWA_Online
tenures.note: The news of 26 February 2008 is signed "Richard Fitzwell reporting for AWA_Online"; another item calls him "the AWA_Online rumor reporter".

caption: Reporter whose bulletins on AWA_Online covered the Vortex accident and the Montreal show in February 2008.
